display.purpose: The window title only, in chalk, uppercase, extra kerning 0.22.

title.purpose: A brain column's name in its ink, the Input panel title, the help heading; 16px for the drop-to-build overlay.

caption.purpose: Region captions, tab names, 'linked'; 9px for corner names, legend and meter names; 11.5px for help section headings.

label.purpose: A control's name above its knob or menu, in dim; 8.5px at 60% ink on the capture chip.

button.purpose: Printed caps on label stock; 11px when the button is 30px or taller.

value.purpose: Value cells, status lines, sound-list rows, the empty message; tick-box text at 11.5px.

menu.purpose: The choice in a menu cell; 12px in the popup and the slider popup.

share.purpose: The leading source's share on a triangle, the largest figure on the sheet.

share-trailing.purpose: The other two corner shares, at 85% alpha.

tag.purpose: Version tag and capture chip; 10px cepstrum tags and credits; 9px row numbers; 9.5px axis figures.

fine.purpose: Axis figures on plots and the quefrency range note.

tooltip.purpose: Tooltip prose on label stock, wrapped at 340px.

prose.purpose: The help sheet's body in navy ink, 3px line spacing.

shadows.name: label-edge
shadows.purpose: The 1px shadow line directly beneath label stock (buttons, front tabs' stock is drawn without it); the only shadow a control carries.

shadows.name: tag-edge
shadows.purpose: The same line beneath a drawTag tag.

shadows.name: help-sheet
shadows.purpose: The help sheet pulled out of the box; the one soft shadow in the system.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: Nothing animates: values, rings and dots update instantly, like a typed entry. Meters fall at 0.04 per 30 Hz tick (hold 0.008) as ballistics, not as styling.

states.idle: Label stock with an 18% ink hairline; knob arc at 78%, pointer 1.6px.
states.lifted: Hover: stock brighter(0.06); knob arc 100%, pointer 2px; value cell ruled 1px ink with a 2px accent along the bottom.
states.on: Same stock and ink, edged 1px in the on-ink with the on-ink 3px along the top; tick box filled in now.
states.disabled: No stock: a 1px outline rectangle with caps in dim; tick-box text at 50%.
states.empty: 'empty: drop a folder of samples here' / 'drop samples or a folder here' typed in dim on the well; Clear and Rebuild disabled.
states.building: Status shows the engine's message; a 5px progress bar in now on well under the status row.
states.linked: Link rings interlocked in the brain's ink; a following triangle at 45% ink with its well at 50% and a dim dot.

narrative.northStar: The Tape Box and the Track Sheet
narrative.overview:
The plugin window is a studio's session box. The dark theme is the box itself: a matte blue-grey card, chalk-white print, and a cream label stuck on wherever a value is typed. The light theme is the track sheet that lives inside the box: cream stock, navy ink, the same inks a shade deeper. Both themes are one world with one grammar; the Theme parameter swaps the palette and nothing else. Three sources (the Input, Brain 1, Brain 2) each own one ink and keep it everywhere they appear: region rules, tab rules, knob arcs, map dots, plot curves, cutoff lines, cepstrum tags. Anything happening right now (the triangle dot, the slice playing, the gate light, the meter above -3 dB, the capture just made) is marked in grease pencil.

The surface is dense and flat. Hierarchy comes from scale and ink weight, never from decoration: the triangle shares are the largest figures on the sheet, the leading source is inked fully while the others sit a step back, and the control under the hand lifts to full ink while its siblings stay put. Everything is drawn in code with hairlines and square corners; there are no image assets and no rounded forms except the dots, rings and knobs that are circles by nature. Nothing animates: values, rings and dots update instantly, like a typed entry.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes, one world: box (dark) and sheet (light) share every rule and differ only in palette.
Three source inks, fixed, used for every mark that belongs to a source.
Grease pencil for "now" and for the result; nothing else is red-orange.
Cream label stock only for small typed fields: value cells, buttons, tags, menus' popups, the sound list, the version, the tooltip, the help sheet.
Barlow for print (captions, labels, titles, prose); Courier New for everything typed (values, menus, status, tags, credits).
Hairline rules, square corners, no fills under knobs, no shadows beyond a 1px shadow line under label stock.
Focus lift: hover brings a knob and its cell to full ink; no other hover treatment exists.

rules.name: The One Ink Per Source Rule
rules.body: A source has one colour and every mark that belongs to it uses that colour: rules, tabs, arcs, rings, dots, curves, lines, tags, titles. Sounds inside a brain are shades of that brain's ink (`forSound`: hue rotated within ±0.05, brightness 55% to 100%, saturation 70% to 100%), so a map never borrows another source's colour.

rules.name: The Grease Pencil Rule
rules.body: The `now` colour marks only what is happening at this moment or has just happened, plus the result the engine is producing. It is never a brand accent, a border on a resting control, or a hover colour.

rules.name: The Label Stock Rule
rules.body: Cream stock is for small typed fields and sheets of print; regions, wells and grounds are never cream in the dark theme. On the sheet (light) the same rule holds with the stock a lighter cream than its ground.

rules.name: The Typed Value Rule
rules.body: Every number, menu choice, status line, filename, tag and the credits line is typed in Courier New. Barlow carries print only: titles, captions, labels, button caps and prose.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Printed text is uppercase (`uppercaseTitles`) and tracked: titles and captions by 0.14, buttons by half that, control labels by a quarter, so long names still fit a 66px cell.

rules.name: The Stuck-On Rule
rules.body: The only shadow a control may carry is the 1px shadow line under label stock. Regions, wells, knobs, menus and tabs cast nothing.

rules.name: The Focus Lift Rule
rules.body: The control under the hand goes to full ink: a knob's arc from 78% to 100% alpha and its pointer from 1.6px to 2px; its value cell is ruled 1px in navy ink with its source's ink 2px thick along the bottom. Siblings stay a step back. No glow, no scale, no colour change elsewhere.

dos: Do give every mark that belongs to a source that source's ink, and every "now" mark the grease pencil.
Do type every value, menu, status and tag in Courier New on label stock or in chalk; print captions and labels in Barlow caps, tracked 0.14 (titles, captions) / 0.07 (buttons) / 0.035 (labels).
Do draw regions, wells and cells as flat rectangles with a 1px `outline` edge; use 3px only for a source rule along a top edge (2px on a front tab).
Do lift the control under the hand to full ink (arc 100%, pointer 2px, cell ruled in ink with a 2px accent) and leave its siblings a step back.
Do keep both themes on the same roles: a new colour is a new role in both `darkStyle()` and `lightStyle()`.
Do rank by scale and ink, not decoration: the leading figure is larger (19px vs 15px) and fully inked.
Do build a well one step darker than its panel; plots and maps are drawn on wells, never directly on a panel.
donts: Don't fill a knob, round a corner, or add a glow; a knob is a thin ring with a pencil pointer on an `outline` track.
Don't cast shadows: the only shadow on a control is the 1px shadow line beneath label stock; the help sheet's soft shadow is the one exception and stays there.
Don't use `now` as an accent, a border on a resting control, or a hover colour; hover is a brightness step on stock or an alpha step on ink.
Don't use cream stock for a region or ground; it is for small typed fields and sheets of print.
Don't animate; values, rings and dots update instantly.
Don't introduce glyph icons or image assets; the chevron, link rings, dots and rings are drawn paths.
Don't set anything in Inter or in a system sans; the two faces in use are Barlow (print) and Courier New (typed).
